#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>

using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 998244353LL;

long long fastPow(long long base, long long exponent) {
    if (exponent <= 0LL) {
        return 1LL;
    }
    long long result = 1LL;
    long long b = exponent;
    long long multiplyBy = base;
    while (b != 0LL) {
        if ((b & 1LL) == 1LL) {
            result = (result * multiplyBy) % MOD;
        }
        b >>= 1;
        if (b != 0LL) {
            multiplyBy = (multiplyBy * multiplyBy) % MOD;
        }
    }
    return result;
}

int main() {
    string line;
    getline(cin, line);
    stringstream ss(line);
    long long N, M, L, R;
    ss >> N >> M >> L >> R;

    long long blocks = N * M;
    long long choices = R - L + 1;
    long long basePow = fastPow(choices, blocks);

    if (blocks % 2 == 1) {
        cout << basePow << endl;
    } else if (choices % 2 == 0) {
        cout << (basePow * ((MOD + 1) / 2) % MOD) << endl;
    } else {
        cout << ((basePow + 1) * ((MOD + 1) / 2) % MOD) << endl;
    }

    return 0;
}
